Reconcile parity manifests with current package ownership; repair required build/test entry points and document supported Node version.
Capture reviewed submodule commits and compatible package versions in a clean reproducible release.
Complete staging deployment, service secrets/configuration, health checks, structured telemetry, backup/restore and rollback runbooks.

A clean recursive checkout installs, builds and passes pipeline parity/component-policy checks in CI.
Required checks run against isolated databases and include every release service; no reliance on uncommitted local files.
Staging deploy and rollback are rehearsed; database restore is verified; operators can diagnose failed jobs and provider outages.

Can start immediately; coordinate shared contracts with other completion epics.

Preserve working functionality, tenant isolation, additive migrations and append-only audit/replay. Keep engines driven by risk-class configuration. Do not present seeded/illustrative figures as verified financial results. Owners and estimates remain unassigned until delivery planning.
